data.name: Emolic
data.gender_notes: Emolic is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ema’ (Goddess) and ‘Lilas’ (Divine play or Love), Emolic represents the embodiment of divine love and compassion. In Hindu mythology, Emolic is revered as the goddess of love, relationships, and marital bliss. The name Emolic carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Compassion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Emolic usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the purest form of love and compassion, inspiring harmony, unity, and emotional depth.
data.etymology: Emolic belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Compassion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emolic total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
